concerns.text: FR‑009 – a pre‑study pilot validation (n=5) of SART and Ospan response‑time ranges (100 ms‑5000 ms) is required by the specification, but no task explicitly performs this pilot. Existing tasks (T002, T003) generate a full‑scale simulation (n=80) and embed response‑time checks, but they do not constitute the mandated pilot check before recruitment. Add a dedicated task (e.g., T000 [US1] “Run pilot validation with 5 participants and verify timing constraints”) and corresponding verification steps.
